basic_details.job_title: NIT Silchar Project Intern Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Mechanical Engineering, National Institute of Technology Silchar, has invited applications from Indian citizens for 2 temporary Project Intern posts on the Govt. of India sponsored TIH-IIT Guwahati project "Design, Development, and Testing of Sediment Erosion- Resistive Micro-Hydro Turbine for off-grid application" (Project Sanction Number TIH/TD/0417). The pay is Rs. 8,000 per month, with H.R.A. as per Project/Institute norms, and the engagement runs till 31 March 2027 or till completion of the project. The essential qualification is B.Tech. (Completed) or M.Tech. (Pre-final

how_to_apply: Fill in the "Format of Application" given on page 2 of the notice. It asks for advertisement number, project title, funding agency, department, personal details, educational qualification starting from Class X, NET/GATE details, employment details and a declaration.
Paste a recent passport size colored photograph on the form and sign the declaration.
Prepare the C.V. and soft copies of all supporting documents. A caste or category certificate is attached if the applicant belongs to SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwD.
Email the duly filled form, the C.V. and the documents to the Principal Investigator at [email protected].
Write the subject line exactly as: Application for the post of Project Intern under the project TIH/TD/0417.
Make sure the application reaches the PI by 23 November 2026. For queries, call the PI at 9402168938.
important_instructions: Employed candidates must bring a no objection certificate from the employer at the time of interview. No TA/DA is paid for the interview or for joining. Selected candidates sign an agreement at the time of joining. The Institute may limit the number of candidates called for interview after screening.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian citizens may apply. The notice prints the following conditions for the single post of Project Intern. Employed candidates must submit a no objection certificate from their employer at the time of interview. Candidates should check the official notification for any further discipline-specific eligibility.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Project Intern receives Rs. 8,000/- per month. The candidate will be eligible for H.R.A. as per the Project/Institute norms. The post is temporary and runs till 31st March 2027 or till completion of the project. All terms and conditions of this recruitment follow the guidelines of the sponsoring agency and NIT Silchar. Selected candidates must sign an agreement at the time of joining.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates are screened on the basis of their applications. The Institute may restrict the number of candidates shortlisted for the interview on the basis of screening. The interview date and mode (online or offline), along with other details, will be notified through email. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview or for joining the post. No candidate may be recruited if suitable candidates are not found.

faq.question: Q1. How many Project Intern posts are there at NIT Silchar?
faq.answer: There are 2 Project Intern posts in the Department of Mechanical Engineering, NIT Silchar, on the TIH-IIT Guwahati sponsored project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for receiving the filled-up application form (soft copy) is 23 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the Project Intern post?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is B.Tech. (Completed) / M.Tech. (Pre-final year). B.Tech. in Mechanical or Agricultural Engineering is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 35 years (on the last date of advertisement). Relaxation on age is as per Govt. of India Rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the NIT Silchar Project Intern?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs. 8,000/- per month. The candidate will be eligible for H.R.A. as per the Project/Institute norms.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Email the duly filled application form, C.V. and soft copies of supporting documents to [email protected]. The subject line must be: Application for the post of Project Intern under the project TIH/TD/0417.

faq.question: Q7. How long does the engagement last?
faq.answer: It is a temporary post, running till 31st March 2027 or till completion of the project.

faq.question: Q8. Will TA/DA be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview or for joining the post.

faq.question: Q9. Do employed candidates need any certificate?
faq.answer: Yes. Employed candidates must submit a no objection certificate from their employer at the time of interview.

faq.question: Q10. How will the interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The interview date and mode (online or offline), along with other details, will be notified through email.
